notes.title: Update 0.8025
notes.notes: We have added 5 new difficulty levels (Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Nightmare). Now you can adjust the game's difficulty to your liking. The difficulty levels do not affect platforming; they weaken or strengthen monsters and bosses. You can change the difficulty at any time in the main menu or pause menu, and it will instantly alter your enemies' attributes.

notes.title: Update 0.8023
notes.notes:
Boss Fight:
Challenge the second boss which can be found in the second level, and try to defeat him to unlock the entrance to the next location.
Use the magic power and move fast to avoid all his minions!

Improvements:
1) you can select another controls preset
2) you can disable ambient occlusion (to fix the problem with weird shadows if they disturbed you)
3) now you can use a magnet stick to magnetize dragon eggs
4) you can switch difficulties in the trolley section

notes.title: Update 0.8022
notes.notes: We have added Sticks Store and first skins which you can unlock with the Dragon Eggs. Also we have fixed problem with sounds when you minimize the game

notes.title: Update 0.8021
notes.notes:
We've added dragon egg pickups. Try to find and collect them all! You must be attentive because some of them are very well hidden, and to reach others, you will need to try hard!

Also we fixed a lot of small bugs, changed the "Virtual Hands Calibration" system, make some late game moments easier.

notes.title: Update 0.8020
notes.notes: Added a possibility to calibrate virtual hands, added a speed modifier setting for the fluent rotation, added a possibility to replay completed levels.

notes.title: Update 0.8019
notes.notes: Fixed Pico controllers position. If you use Pico headset, then open the Controls menu and switch the "Pico Headset" parameter

notes.title: Update 0.8018
notes.notes:
Challenge the first boss in the Village, and try to defeat him to unlock the entrance to the next location.
Use the full power of first sticks, and be quick to avoid all his attacks!

notes.title: Update 0.8015
notes.notes: Added per level statistics, fixed problems with input when use Virtual Desktop
